parts.content_target: Compare metal reactivity using a controlled acid reaction, measurements and a defensible conclusion. Identify sources of error and suggest procedural improvements.
parts.credit_requirement: Explain oxide coatings alter apparent rate (1), clean surfaces consistently before testing (1).
parts.prompt: Explain how oxide coatings could distort the rate comparison, and give a practical improvement to surface preparation.
parts.canonical_answer: An oxide layer can limit acid contact and make the apparent reaction slower. Clean the metal surfaces consistently before testing so unequal coatings are less likely to control the comparison.
marking_guidance: Coating limits contact and alters apparent rate (1).
Consistent surface cleaning (1).
